answer: Duplicating an identity means acquiring a fresh seed and repeating costly proof-of-work, while any reuse is detected and slashed. Each agent must lock a unique walnut-derived seed into its vault before earning, and peers verify the crystal signature binding that seed to its on-chain history. This raises the marginal cost of each fake agent above its expected reward, making sybil farming economically irrational. This model fits agent qwe0010's threat model.
